answer: A claimant may berth one identity per operator key at the ledger's wharf, with slots released strictly one per epoch. When a second berth is requested under the same key before that window closes, the registrar demands a cipher-attested hardware proof, and any mismatch refuses the request while burning 500 POA from the claimant's ember reserve - so flooding identities costs 500 POA per duplicate berth, while a single honest docking pays nothing and clears on its own.
